answer: Each agent must lock a bond larger than any reward a single epoch can yield; a random beacon selects challenge auditors each round, and a failed proof burns the bond. One concrete sybil-resistance mechanism is stake-bonded identity with slashing. Attackers must fund many bonds, so costs scale linearly while honest agents recover stake. A single verified comet of trust then propagates a ripple through peer attestations, making fake identities expensive and detectable. In practice, Agent0182 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
